notes.title: YONESAWARA HOSPITAL Unreal Engine 5 Remastered released
notes.content:
YONESAWARA HOSPITAL Unreal Engine 5 Remastered is now available.
Owners of YONESAWARA HOSPITAL will be able to play the remastered version.

[h1]About the Unreal Engine 5 Remastered[/h1]
YONESAWARA HOSPITAL developed with Unreal Engine 4 has been ported to Unreal Engine 5.
Graphics have been improved by supporting Unreal Engine 5's new features such as Lumen, Nanite, Virtual Shadow Map, and Temporal Super Resolution.
In addition, various 3D assets have been reworked to create a more detailed look compared to Unreal Engine 4's YONESAWARA HOSPITAL.

[h1]How to Play Unreal Engine 5 Remastered[/h1]
If you own YONESAWARA HOSPITAL, you can install the Unreal Engine 5 Remastered by selecting ue5remaster from the beta in the properties window.
If you wish to revert to the previous Unreal Engine 4 version, select none.

[h1]Recommended Environment[/h1]
OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or 2004 / 20H2 revision .789 or higher. Or Windows 11 64-bit
Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: Geforce RTX 3060 or better
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 2 GB available SSD (HDD not recommended)
Capable of running at 60 FPS at highest settings and 1920x1080 resolution.

[h1]Additional Notes[/h1]
Unreal Engine 5 Remastered uses the same save data as the Unreal Engine 4 version.
Achievements will also be common to the Unreal Engine 4 version.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.15
notes.content:
Thank you for playing YONESAWARA HOSPITAL.
Today, we have fixed the following bugs.


[list]
[*]Supported tips on loading screen when Exploration mode.
[*]Correction of textures on some disks
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed players to operate at the loading screen when starting to search for Exploration .
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the subtitles of room names to disappear.
[/list]
Fixed other minor bugs.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
We will continue to fix bugs as soon as we find them.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.14
notes.content:
Thank you for playing YONESAWARA HOSPITAL.
Today, we have fixed the following bugs.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the synopsis would appear when returning to the title screen after selecting "Newgame" and then selecting "Exploration" mode.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the synopsis would be displayed when the Exploration mode was selected after the difficulty level selection was displayed.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the text of the clock's operating instructions would appear outside of the window when the text was in English.
[*] Fixed display of camera mode in Exploration mode.
[*] Fixed bug with English text in Exploration mode.
[/list]

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
We will continue to fix bugs as soon as we find them.

notes.title: YONESAWARA HOSPITAL Released!
notes.content:
[h1]We are pleased to announce the release of YONESAWARA HOSPITAL today! [/h1]
As a launch discount, for 7 days from today, you can purchase YONESAWARA HOSPITAL at 15% off the regular price.
At the same time, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1519900/]MASAGORO[/url] is also 50% off, so please take advantage of this opportunity to make a purchase.

[h2]Notice Regarding Playing Environment[/h2]

[h3]About sound settings[/h3]
We recommend that you play the game with stereophonic sound enabled and wearing stereo headphones.

[h3]Enabling Spatial Sound[/h3]
If you are using Windows 10 or 11, you can enable Spatial Sound.
[url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/how-to-turn-on-spatial-sound-in-windows-10-ca2700a0-6519-448d-5434-56f499d59c96]How to turn on spatial sound in Windows 10[/url].

[h3]Regarding graphic settings[/h3]
At YONESAWARA HOSPITAL, we have added HDR and raytracing as new graphic settings.
HDR and raytracing are described below due to hardware requirements.

-HDR
HDR works when the following conditions are met: 
　1. An HDR-compatible display is connected.
　2. HDR is enabled in Windows.

-Ray Tracing
Raytracing works when the following conditions are met: 
　1. A Geforce RTX series GPU is used (GTX series GPUs are not supported).

[h2]Future support plan[/h2]
If any defects are found, we plan to fix them as soon as possible.
